Lunta is a reference manager for scientific papers: your library, a reading view made from each paper, highlights and notes, citations in Word and Google Docs, and sync across your devices.

## Which file do I need?

| Your computer or phone | Download | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| **Mac** (Apple silicon: M1 or newer) | [`Lunta-VERSION-Mac-AppleSilicon.zip`](https://github.com/christoffermattssonlangseth/lunta/releases/download/vVERSION/Lunta-VERSION-Mac-AppleSilicon.zip) | Unzip and drag **Lunta** to Applications. Signed and notarized by Apple. |
| **Windows** | [`Lunta-VERSION-Windows-Setup.exe`](https://github.com/christoffermattssonlangseth/lunta/releases/download/vVERSION/Lunta-VERSION-Windows-Setup.exe) | Run the installer. ([`Lunta-VERSION-Windows.msi`](https://github.com/christoffermattssonlangseth/lunta/releases/download/vVERSION/Lunta-VERSION-Windows.msi) is the same app for managed installs.) |
| **Linux** (Ubuntu, Debian) | [`Lunta-VERSION-Linux-Ubuntu-Debian.deb`](https://github.com/christoffermattssonlangseth/lunta/releases/download/vVERSION/Lunta-VERSION-Linux-Ubuntu-Debian.deb) | `sudo apt install ./Lunta-VERSION-Linux-Ubuntu-Debian.deb` |
| **Linux** (any other) | [`Lunta-VERSION-Linux.AppImage`](https://github.com/christoffermattssonlangseth/lunta/releases/download/vVERSION/Lunta-VERSION-Linux.AppImage) | Make it executable (`chmod +x`) and run it. |
| **Android** | [`Lunta-VERSION-Android.apk`](https://github.com/christoffermattssonlangseth/lunta/releases/download/vVERSION/Lunta-VERSION-Android.apk) | Open it on the phone and allow installing from this source. Later versions install over it. |
| iPhone | — | Not on this page; it comes through TestFlight or the App Store. |

**Source code** (zip / tar.gz) is the project's code at this version; you don't need it to use Lunta.

## Sharing one library

The Mac and iPhone keep the library in iCloud. Android, Windows and Linux use a "Lunta" folder in Google Drive: on the Mac, **Lunta › Google Drive for Android…** keeps the two in sync.
